description: This Java class provides utility methods for processing batch command URLs, including extracting query parameters, handling URL versioning, and modifying URI info objects within the Apache Fineract project.

classes.name: CommandStrategyUtils
classes.description: A utility class for handling command URL strategies within batch processing, including parsing query parameters and URL versioning logic.

methods.name: getQueryParameters
methods.description: Extracts query parameters from a relative URL into a map of key-value pairs.

methods.name: addQueryParametersToUriInfo
methods.description: Adds query parameters from a map to a MutableUriInfo object.

methods.name: relativeUrlWithoutVersion
methods.description: Removes version prefix from a relative URL, if present, returning the URL without versioning.

methods.name: isResourceVersioned
methods.description: Checks if the resource URL in a CommandContext is versioned.

methods.name: isRelativeUrlVersioned
methods.description: Determines whether a given relative URL is versioned based on its pattern.
